Published the column "2022 total (million tonnes)" for Household, Food service, Retail and Total, exactly as printed ("1 052" is read as 1,052).

published_value.quote: The results indicate that 1.05 billion tonnes of food were wasted across the three sectors considered in this report in 2022 (Table 23), equal to 132 kilograms per capita per year.

scope.basis: SDG 12.3.1b food waste in 2022: food and its associated inedible parts (bones, peels, shells) removed from the human food supply at household, food service and retail level. Food lost before retail (SDG 12.3.1a) and in manufacturing is not included. Not comparable with the 2021 report's 2019 estimates (different data and methods).
